# Vendored headers

Single-header libraries, pinned and checked into the tree so the build needs no
network. `SHA256SUMS` is verified in CI; update it together with the file.

| File | Project | Version | Licence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `doctest/doctest.h` | doctest | 2.5.3 | MIT | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doctest/doctest/v2.5.3/doctest/doctest.h |
| `nlohmann/json.hpp` | nlohmann/json | 3.12.0 | MIT | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp |

Both licences are reproduced at the top of each header.
